name: Hybrid STE+SPSA Gradient Estimation
definition: A hybrid strategy combining vanilla STE and Simultaneous Perturbation Stochastic Approximation (SPSA). STE is used during cached steps, while SPSA is applied only when the codec cache is refreshed.
summary: Hybrid STE+SPSA combines vanilla STE with SPSA to reduce gradient bias during codec cache refreshes, though it incurs higher variance and training time.
